mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing tramadol levels and serotonin activity, while both agents have antiplatelet properties that may increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor patients for increased tramadol effects (dizziness, nausea, serotonin syndrome symptoms) and bleeding signs; consider dose adjustment if using high-dose turmeric supplements.
